body.prompt: Early morning in the year 170, inside a quiet stone study of a Roman villa, an older Roman emperor in his fifties with short curly grey-brown hair and a short curly grey beard, in a plain off-white wool tunic and a deep crimson cloak, no crown sits at a plain wooden desk beside a tall open window, seen from behind his right shoulder so his face is not visible, writing on a small wax tablet with a bronze stylus, the writing on the tablet is only faint abstract scratches, golden sunrise light pouring in across the desk, a clay oil lamp just put out with a thin curl of smoke, cypress trees and distant hills outside. Camera at shoulder height, still. Cinematic oil-painting look like a sunlit Neoclassical painting brought to life, soft warm golden daylight, cream marble, terracotta, olive green and pale sky blue palette, gentle haze, fine film grain, painterly texture, vertical 9:16 frame, main subject in the lower two-thirds, a calm softly lit empty area in the top third. Absolutely no text, no letters, no numbers, no inscriptions on stone, no logos, no watermark, no modern objects anywhere.
